那道身影怒目圆睁，气势威猛，周身散发着凛然正气，正是罚恶司的主官，鼎鼎大名的阴阳驱魔真君——钟馗大判！

吴姜心中一凛，连忙收敛心神，恭敬地躬身行礼，语气庄重：“二等鬼差吴姜，见过判官大人！”

钟馗大判看着威严可怖，说话的语气却十分温和，缓缓开口：

“不必多礼，起身吧。详细将事情的来龙去脉，说给本判听听。”

吴姜直起身，定了定神，将两次遇到怨煞染运术，以及自己的担忧，又原原本本的复述了一遍。

钟馗大判端坐宝座，双目微眯，认真地听着，黑白无常也收起了笑意，神色严肃。

吴姜讲述完经过，大殿内陷入短暂的寂静，唯有烛火跳动的噼啪声，在空旷肃穆的殿内缓缓回荡，更添几分凝重。

钟馗神情凝重，沉默片刻，缓缓开口：“吴姜，你所言之事，非同小可。怨煞染运术阴邪歹毒，窃取阳间之人的运数。而运数乃天定，无疑是公然扰乱阴阳秩序，此等恶行，发现一起，必当严惩不贷。若你能协助将这背后的邪道捉拿归案，对我地府而言，便是大功一件。”

钟馗说到此处，手一扬，一道金光从他袖口飞出，缓缓落在吴姜面前。

“此令牌你收好，若是邪道出现，你可凭此令牌传讯，自会有地府阴差，前去助你！”

吴姜心中一喜，连忙双手接过令牌，原本心中的担忧瞬间消散大半。

他恭敬地躬身行礼，语气庄重而感激：“多谢判官大人！只要邪道现身，属下必第一时间传讯地府，绝不辜负大人所托！”

有了这块地府传讯令牌，就算那邪道真的是修炼多年的老妖怪，他也有恃无恐了，再强，还能强的过地府吗？

钟馗摆了摆手，示意他和朱宏可以退下了，吴姜和朱宏再次向判官大人、黑白无常躬身行礼，随后转身，退出了大殿。

走出罚恶司，吴姜脸上是掩饰不住的雀跃，之前心中的担忧早已烟消云散，甚至隐隐有些期待起来，巴不得那邪道赶紧找上门才好。

回勾魂司的路上，吴姜和朱宏说说笑笑，就在两人走到一处拐角时，吴姜眼角的余光，突然瞥见拐角处闪过一抹熟悉的倩影，那身影身着一袭素色长裙，身姿窈窕，哪怕只是匆匆一瞥，吴姜也觉得格外眼熟。

That figure's eyes were wide open with anger, and he had a mighty aura. He exuded awe-inspiring righteousness. He was none other than the chief officer of the Punishment Department, the famous Yin-Yang Exorcist True Lord - Zhong Kui!

Wu Jiang's heart trembled, and he quickly calmed down, bowed respectfully, and said in a solemn tone: "Second-class ghost officer Wu Jiang has met the judge!"

Judge Zhong Kui looked majestic and terrifying, but his tone of voice was very gentle, and he spoke slowly:

"No need to be polite, just get up. Tell me the whole story of the matter in detail."

Wu Jiang straightened up, calmed down, and recounted the two encounters with the Resentful Evil Ran Luck Technique, as well as his worries, exactly as they were.

Grand Judge Zhong Kui sat on the throne, his eyes slightly narrowed, and he listened carefully. Black and White Wuchang also stopped smiling and looked serious.

After Wu Jiang finished telling the story, the hall fell into a brief silence. Only the crackling sound of candlelight slowly echoed in the empty and solemn hall, adding a bit of solemnity.

Zhong Kui looked solemn, silent for a moment, and then spoke slowly: "Wu Jiang, what you are talking about is not trivial. The evil spirit dyed with luck is evil and evil, and steals the luck of people in the world. The luck is determined by heaven, and it is undoubtedly a blatant disruption of the order of yin and yang. Such evil deeds must be severely punished if they are discovered together. If you can help to arrest the evil behind this, it will be a great achievement for our underworld."

When Zhong Kui said this, he raised his hand, and a golden light flew out from his sleeves and slowly landed in front of Wu Jiang.

"Keep this token away. If evil appears, you can use this token to send a message, and there will be people from the underworld who will come to help you!"

Wu Jiang felt happy and quickly took the token with both hands. Most of the worries in his heart disappeared instantly.

He bowed respectfully and said in a solemn and grateful tone: "Thank you, Lord Judge! As long as evil appears, I will summon the underworld as soon as possible, and I will never let you down!"

With this communication token from the underworld, even if the evil spirit is really an old monster who has been practicing for many years, he will have nothing to fear. No matter how strong he is, can he still be stronger than the underworld?

Zhong Kui waved his hand, indicating that he and Zhu Hong could leave. Wu Jiang and Zhu Hong bowed to the Lord Judge and Black and White Wuchang again, then turned around and exited the hall.

Walking out of the Evil Punishment Department, Wu Jiang couldn't hide the joy on his face. The worries in his heart had long since disappeared, and he was even vaguely looking forward to it, hoping that the evil would come to his door as soon as possible.

On the way back to the Soul Enchanting Division, Wu Jiang and Zhu Hong were chatting and laughing. When the two of them came to a corner, Wu Jiang suddenly caught a glimpse of a familiar figure flashing around the corner. The figure was wearing a plain dress and had a slim figure. Even at a quick glance, Wu Jiang felt that it looked particularly familiar.
